title: Unescaped JSON in HTML or script sink
message: JSON.stringify is embedded in HTML/script markup without HTML-escaping; data containing `</script>` or `<` breaks out and becomes XSS.
help: JSON.stringify does not HTML-escape, so a `</script>` (or `<`) in the data breaks out and becomes XSS. Use an HTML-safe serializer (serialize-javascript, devalue) or escape `<`, `>`, and `&`, or pass data via a JSON `<script type="application/json">` read with JSON.parse.
